ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

14. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Precautions when using and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain School environment environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping Safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
